about.title: About
about.guideContent:
1. Language / timezone / theme: the toolbar switches language, timezone (all times shown in your chosen timezone) and theme (Pixel / Museum).
2. Current status: see which months are accepting lottery entries and which are on sale now.
3. Next release: see the next on-sale date with a countdown; add it to Google Calendar or download the .ics file for your system calendar.
4. Ticket calculator: pick your planned visit month to see the full timeline (lottery entry → results → first-come sale), then add it to a calendar or share it.
5. Release schedule: an overview of the next 6 months of lottery and sale dates.
6. All times are estimates — always confirm on the official website, and buy only there to avoid scams.
about.rulesIntro: Nintendo Museum tickets are sold through two channels (both require a Nintendo Account):
about.rulesLottery: Lottery (Drawing): entries open 3 months before your visit month (on the 1st of the month at 10:00 JST), and results are announced 2 months before (on the 1st at 16:00 JST). Winners must pay within the given deadline.
about.rulesFirstCome: First-come (On Sale): after the lottery results, tickets open for direct purchase in the middle of that month (usually the 2nd Wednesday at 16:00 JST), until sold out.
about.rulesNote: Some months are exceptions (e.g. May 2026 tickets went on sale on the 2nd Thursday morning). Rules may change at any time — always check the official Nintendo Museum website.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: This is a fan-made tool and is NOT the official Nintendo Museum website. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or approved by Nintendo.
disclaimer.timeNote: Ticket release times are inferred from historical patterns and official announcements and are provided for reference only. Always check the official Nintendo Museum website for the latest schedule.
disclaimer.responsibility: This tool makes no guarantee that you will be able to purchase tickets. We are not responsible for any losses caused by schedule changes or failed purchases.
disclaimer.trademark: Nintendo and all related trademarks and names are the property of their respective owners.
disclaimer.rulesChange: The official sale rules (lottery / first-come method, dates and times) may change at any time without notice. This tool is not synced in real time — always confirm on the official website.
disclaimer.privacy: This tool does not collect or upload any personal information. All preferences (language, timezone, theme) are stored only locally in your browser.
disclaimer.scam: Beware of scams: buy tickets only on the official website and never provide your Nintendo Account information to unofficial channels.
disclaimer.externalLinks: External links (such as the official website) are provided for reference only; we are not responsible for their content or security.
disclaimer.asIs: This tool is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, and may be modified or discontinued at any time without notice.
